items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NDk4MTMsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--00a5870a9a8d556fc7ff2c92c46d6963e9ae4652/image.png)
​
The **Negros Speedcubers Organizing Committee** (NSOC) presents **MassKara Cubing Festival**.
​
* All the necessary information can be found in the tabs above.
* If you are interested in participating, the full registration details can be found [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MasskaraSpeedcubingCup2025#63716-payment-and-registration).
* Please be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/full/) before participating.
* Please take note that the schedule given is not fixed and may run ahead or behind depending on the competition flow that day. Please stay updated and be ready for any adjustments. We also recommend arriving at least 30 minutes before your event to avoid missing it.
​
###### *By participating in this event, competitors and their guests—including but not limited to family members, friends, and guardians—acknowledge that the organizing bodies, their staff, and affiliated individuals will not be liable, to the fullest extent permitted by law, for any injuries, loss of personal belongings, or emotional distress resulting from participation in this competition.*

items.name: New York Championship 2025
items.information:
This is the New York Championship, but anyone can compete regardless of their state of residence. See more information on the Championship Eligibility tab.

This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the WCA regulations. If you are new to competing, please refer to the Competition Procedures tab.

items.name: Mission Viejo Fall 2025

venue.name: Tesoro High School
venue.address: 1 Tesoro Creek Rd, Las Flores, CA 92688, United States

items.information:
This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MissionViejoFall2025#62472-competitor-responsibilities) tab.

Spectators can attend for free and can come and go as they please! No registration or check-in process is needed for spectating.

This competition is organized in partnership with [West Coast Cubing](https://www.westcoastcubing.com/) and [SpeedCubeShop](https://speedcubeshop.com/).

**UA Students & Alumni:** After registering, send an ACT card screenshot or proof of a crimson email address to the organizers to qualify for the reduced registration fee of $15.

**Note:** Competitors under the age of 18 must be accompanied by a parent/guardian at all times.
